nodes.label: IETF RFC 8391 eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS)
nodes.description: Post-quantum stateful hash-based digital signature standard utilizing Merkle trees over Winternitz one-time signature schemes (WOTS+) for forward-secure cryptographic provenance.

nodes.label: Khoja Arabic Morphological Root-Based Stemming Algorithm
nodes.description: Algorithmic root extraction method for Arabic text parsing that strips prefixes, suffixes, and inflections to map lexical tokens to triliteral canonical roots.

nodes.label: FPGA-Accelerated Direct Memory Access (DMA) Ring-0 Kernel Subsystem
nodes.description: Kernel-bypass high-throughput DMA subsystem offloading graph traversal and vector transformation directly to hardware logic without host CPU context switches.

nodes.label: VF2+ Subgraph Isomorphism Matching Algorithm
nodes.description: Optimized graph topology analysis algorithm featuring candidate filtering, state-space tree pruning, and fast isomorphism matching across large property graphs.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-Star / SPARQL-Star Quoted Triple Data Model Specification
nodes.description: Extension to the RDF data model allowing statement nesting (triples about triples) to represent metadata, probabilities, and temporal scopes without reification.
